question: 2026 年 8 月的总销售额
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT SUM(orders.paid_amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM orders WHERE orders.paid_amount > 0 AND orders.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND orders.paid_at < '2026-09-01' LIMIT 1000

question: 长沙门店 2026 年 8 月的销售额
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = '长沙' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o JOIN stores AS s ON o.store_id = s.store_id WHERE s.city = '长沙' AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月销量最高的品牌
golden_sql: SELECT oi.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY oi.brand ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT oi.brand, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.paid_amount > 0 AND o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY oi.brand ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年上半年各月的销售额
golden_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at) AS ym, SUM(paid_amount) AS sales FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND paid_at < '2026-07-01' AND paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY ym ORDER BY ym
sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) AS month, SUM(o.paid_amount) AS sales_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) ORDER BY month LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月的总利润
golden_sql: SELECT SUM(profit_amount) AS profit FROM orders WHERE paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND paid_amount > 0
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.subtotal_profit), 0) AS total_profit FROM order_items AS oi INNER JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

question: 2026 年 8 月利润率最高的商品类目
golden_sql: SELECT oi.category, SUM(oi.subtotal_profit) / SUM(oi.line_paid_amount) AS margin FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY oi.category ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 1
sql: SELECT oi.category, SUM(oi.subtotal_profit) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.line_paid_amount), 0) AS profit_margin FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY oi.category ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 1

question: 2026 年 8 月相比 7 月，销售额环比增长最快的类目
golden_sql: WITH aug AS (SELECT category, SUM(line_paid_amount) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-09-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY category), jul AS (SELECT category, SUM(line_paid_amount) AS s FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.paid_at >= '2026-07-01' AND o.paid_at < '2026-08-01' AND o.paid_amount > 0 GROUP BY category) SELECT aug.category, (aug.s - jul.s) / jul.s AS growth FROM aug JOIN jul ON aug.category = jul.category WHERE jul.s > 0 ORDER BY growth DESC LIMIT 1

question: 最近一次快照中库存低于安全线的 SKU 数量
golden_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) AND quantity_available < reorder_level
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.sku_code) AS sku_count FROM inventory_snapshots AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) AND s.quantity_available < s.reorder_level LIMIT 1000

question: 最近一次快照中库存量最多的 10 个商品
golden_sql: SELECT product_id, quantity_on_hand FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) ORDER BY quantity_on_hand DESC LIMIT 10
sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.sku_code, p.brand, p.category, s.quantity_available AS inventory_quantity FROM inventory_snapshots AS s JOIN products AS p ON s.product_id = p.product_id WHERE s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM inventory_snapshots) ORDER BY s.quantity_available DESC LIMIT 10

question: 2026 年 8 月各门店的缺货率（可用库存为 0 的记录占比）
golden_sql: SELECT store_id, SUM(CASE WHEN quantity_available = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS stockout_rate FROM inventory_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY store_id
sql: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN i.quantity_available = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS stockout_rate FROM stores AS s LEFT JOIN inventory_snapshots AS i ON s.store_id = i.store_id AND i.snapshot_date >= '2026-08-01' AND i.snapshot_date < '2026-09-01' WHERE s.is_active = 1 GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name ORDER BY s.store_id LIMIT 1000
